name: crystal_search
description: Search and list crystals in the cave with multi-dimensional filtering, or search and inspect DAG transition nodes when crystal_id is provided.

aging.description: Filter by aging category (active, solid, stale)

all.description: When crystal_id is provided, return all matching nodes without pagination cap

crystal_id.description: When provided, scopes search or listing to DAG nodes within the specified crystal, returning matching nodes

has_active_leases.description: Filter crystals holding active transient resource leases

has_lessons.description: Filter crystals with recorded lessons learned

has_open_tasks.description: Filter crystals with incomplete acceptance criteria

include_archived.description: Include crystals in cold storage (default: false)

json_output.description: Output structured JSON array instead of text table (default: false)

kind.description: When crystal_id is provided, filter nodes by kind

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page (default: 20; 0 to uncap)

query.description: Free-text search query across crystal ID, title, intent, DAG nodes, lessons, and artifacts

since.description: Filter crystals active on or after ISO-8601 date/datetime or relative expression (today, yesterday, 1d, 7d)

touching_path.description: Match leases or artifacts referencing the specified filesystem path or URI

until.description: Filter crystals active on or before ISO-8601 date/datetime or relative expression
